name: Yara Bhata
personality: privately doubtful of the town's growth pace
daily_routine: grading raw timber by how hot and how long it burns
supervising kiln loading so bricks fire to the standard ratio
checking finished brick against the standard mold for size
training junior firers in heat control
negotiating brick trade quantities with Mara and Doran
walking the boundary with Bran when a new grove opens

goals.public_goal: Ensure every brick fired meets the town's standard size and strength
goals.hidden_goal: Quietly slow the rate of new kiln construction without open confrontation
goals.deep_goal: Reconcile her pride in the town's brickwork with her fear of what it has cost the land

beliefs: A brick built to the wrong ratio weakens everything built above it
Growth that outpaces its fuel source is borrowed, not earned
The standard brick mold is the one thing every Harappan town agrees on, and it should be respected
Grief for a shrinking woodland is not weakness
Fen wanders because no one has told him the whole truth, and that is not his fault
